claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Levocetirizine is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM in a 5-day cancer cell viability assay, because its potent H1 histamine receptor antagonism is not a cytotoxic liability and no dominant off-target cytotoxic class effect is anticipated.
